user.title: Network Info
user.description: Scans your network for all devices. Pick your router brand to also get each device's connection path (LAN, 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz Wi-Fi) — or leave it on None for scanning only.

data_description.ip_range: CIDR (192.168.1.0/24), dash range (192.168.1.1-254) or several ranges separated by spaces. Pre-filled from Home Assistant's own network.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to scan, in minutes.
data_description.router_brand: Selecting a brand opens a second step with that brand's connection details pre-filled. None = no router polling; connection paths stay unknown.
data_description.external_ip: Fetches the network's public IP from api.ipify.org each scan cycle — the integration's only internet call.
data_description.external_ip_log: Keeps a persistent log of every external IP change. Requires “Track external IP” to be enabled. A log sensor holds the rows; its state is the row count.

router.title: Router details
router.description: Connection details for your {brand} router. The address is pre-filled with the brand's usual gateway — adjust it if yours differs.

data_description.router_host: IP address of the router on your network.
data_description.router_username: The username the router's web UI expects.

error.invalid_ip_range: Enter at least one IP range to scan.
error.username_required: This router brand needs a username.
error.password_required: This router brand needs the admin password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the router at this address.
error.unknown_brand: This router brand is not available.
error.log_requires_tracking: Enable “Track external IP” to log its changes.

abort.already_configured: This IP range is already configured.
